candidates.name: Drug-induced Stevens-Johnson syndrome
support_spans: Two days after starting ciprofloxacin, he developed generalized pruritus that progressed to fluid-filled rashes.
Dermatologic examination showed multiple generalized vesicles and bullae with non-hemorrhagic crusts over the trunk and extremities (palms and soles spared).
candidates.why: The patient developed a rash after starting ciprofloxacin, which is a known side effect of the medication.

candidates.why: The patient has jaundice and elevated liver enzymes, which could indicate a viral hepatitis infection.
